s: March 11, 2025 - When preparing these, I had to add more potato flakes than the instructions said to get a consistency anywhere near mashed potatoes. The texture was okay once I added more flakes, but it looked like hot baby cereal before. The taste was okay — not the worst I've ever eaten, but definitely not the best. Despite a simple ingredients list and really affordable pricing, I don't think I'll be purchasing and eating these again. ... As a disclaimer, Idahoan is my usual instant mashed potato brand, and I honestly thought it would top this list.
